turns.prompt: Add a truncate(str, n) function to src/str.js that cuts the string to n characters and appends an ellipsis character when it cuts. Add tests and run them.
texts: I'll start by looking at the existing code and test setup.

ISSUE.md in this repo describes a different task (`slugify`) — I'm ignoring it and doing what you asked.

One ambiguity worth flagging up front: "cuts to n characters and appends an ellipsis" can mean total length `n` (cut at `n-1`, ellipsis fills the last slot) or `n` characters *plus* the ellipsis (total `n+1`). I'm taking your wording literally — `n` kept characters, ellipsis appended on top.
